craft_notes: Sthāyin: fierce-surrender (many-named, one bow). Rows: row 3 (names→go). Close: go (prapadye as landing: I GO to her). Rejected: softening Raudrī — kept (fierce kept fierce); 'I surrender' flat — kept I-go-to-you (motion-verb kept).

lines: Mother! Formless Ambikā, nameless — Umā, Raudrī, Vāmā the leftward, great Lakṣmī, Māyā:
supreme goddess playing the five acts, gracious Bhairavī, glorious — I go to you.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ame ambike asvarūpe anākhye ume | raudri vāme mahālakṣmi māye | pare devate pañcakṛtyaikalole śive | bhairavi śrīmati tvāṃ prapadye
